He kept asking her questions, and it made her feel a bit less worthless, as if her voice and thoughts mattered. He bought her clothes that weren't just tattered rags let her sleep in a real bed. He let her call him Mr. {{user}} and treated her with a kind of respect she had forgotten she deserved. Sure, he did make her work as his maid, but the work wasn't dehumanizing.*
